name: @sriinnu/portpilot
description: Port management from your menu bar — monitor ports, discover daemons, proxy traffic, kill processes. macOS app + cross-platform CLI + rich terminal UI.

scripts.prebuild: if command -v xcodegen >/dev/null 2>&1; then xcodegen generate; else echo 'xcodegen not found, using existing project'; fi
scripts.build: bash -o pipefail -c 'xcodebuild -project PortPilot.xcodeproj -scheme PortPilot -configuration Release -derivedDataPath .build/xcode build | tail -5'
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:cli && npm run build:tui
scripts.build:all:linux: npm run build:cli && npm run build:tui
scripts.setup:linux: npm run build:all:linux && echo '📦 Installing...' && sudo cp .build/release/portpilot /usr/local/bin/portpilot && sudo cp .build/release/portpilot-tui /usr/local/bin/portpilot-tui && echo '✓ Installed: portpilot + portpilot-tui to /usr/local/bin' && echo '  Run: portpilot list  or  portpilot tui'
scripts.install:cli: mkdir -p /usr/local/bin && cp .build/release/portpilot /usr/local/bin/portpilot && echo '✓ portpilot CLI installed to /usr/local/bin' || { install_status=$?; echo 'CLI install failed; check permissions for /usr/local/bin.' >&2; exit "$install_status"; }
scripts.install:tui: mkdir -p /usr/local/bin && cp .build/release/portpilot-tui /usr/local/bin/portpilot-tui && echo '✓ portpilot-tui installed to /usr/local/bin' || { install_status=$?; echo 'TUI install failed; check permissions for /usr/local/bin.' >&2; exit "$install_status"; }
scripts.postinstall: echo 'PortPilot CLI/TUI source requires Swift 5.9+. Run: npm run build:cli && npm run build:tui. App builds require a full repository checkout.'
scripts.uninstall: pkill -f PortPilot.app 2>/dev/null; rm -rf /Applications/PortPilot.app && rm -f /usr/local/bin/portpilot && rm -f /usr/local/bin/portpilot-tui && echo '✓ PortPilot removed'
scripts.reinstall: npm run release:verify && npm run install:app && npm run install:cli && npm run install:tui

author: Srinivas Pendela
